prompt: We waited indoors during the heavy storm, and finally the dark clouds ___.
explanation_ru: Глагол disappear непереходный (тучи рассеялись сами) и никогда не используется в пассивном залоге: disappeared.

prompt: I walk through the central park on my way to work. Usually, the main gates (to open) at seven in the morning. Yesterday, a park worker (to open) them late because a tree branch blocked the path.
explanation_ru: Обычное расписание открытия ворот выражено пассивом (are opened), а конкретное действие рабочего в прошлом — активом (opened).

prompt: I am upset because food prices at our local store (to rise) twice this month.
explanation_ru: Глагол rise непереходный (цены выросли сами), а указание this month требует Present Perfect Active: have risen.

prompt: Please take a seat while all customer forms (to check) by the bank staff.
explanation_ru: Сотрудники банка проверяют анкеты прямо сейчас (while), поэтому нужен Present Continuous Passive: are being checked.

prompt: Beth asked the station worker about the grey umbrella that ___ to her brother.
explanation_ru: Глагол belong (принадлежать) не употребляется в пассиве; для единственного числа (umbrella) нужен актив: belongs.

prompt: Welcome to the museum: if you sign the guest book, you (to give) a free map.
explanation_ru: В главной части условного предложения первого типа используется Future Simple Passive: will be given.

prompt: My phone screen went dark while I (to send) a voice message to my sister.
explanation_ru: Я сам отправлял сообщение в момент, когда погас экран в прошлом (went dark), поэтому нужен Past Continuous Active: was sending.

prompt: The hiring team liked the top candidates from today's meetings. Three people (to invite) for a second talk tomorrow. Each candidate (to meet) the team leader in the main room.
explanation_ru: Кандидатов пригласят на собеседование (пассив: will be invited), а затем каждый из них сам встретится с руководителем (актив: will meet).

prompt: Our school basketball team ___ at the sports hall when the lights suddenly went out.
explanation_ru: Команда сама тренировалась в момент отключения света (went out), поэтому используется Past Continuous Active: was training.

prompt: Dean forgot about the dinner in the oven, so the meat (to burn) completely.
explanation_ru: Мясо сгорело в духовке в рамках рассказа о прошлом (forgot), поэтому используется Past Simple Passive: was burned.

prompt: Most boxes are inside the flat, and the broken front lock is repairing right now.
answer: Most boxes are inside the flat, and the broken front lock is being repaired right now.
accepted_answers: Most boxes are inside the flat, and the broken front lock is being repaired right now.
explanation_ru: Замок не чинит сам себя — его ремонтируют сейчас, поэтому нужен Present Continuous Passive: is being repaired.

prompt: Jane looked out of her window while the family next door ___ their old car.
explanation_ru: Семья сама мыла свою машину (есть прямое дополнение their old car), поэтому нужен Past Continuous Active: was washing.

prompt: I check my work messages on my computer every morning. Important client emails (to answer) before noon. Today, our office internet (to work) very slowly, so I (to send) short replies from my phone instead.
explanation_ru: Регулярная обработка писем передаётся через Present Simple Passive (are answered), а текущие действия сегодня — через Present Continuous Active (is working, am sending).

prompt: Please keep your boarding pass ready near gate four. Right now, your big bags (to load) onto the plane. You (to board) the aircraft in about ten minutes.
explanation_ru: Багаж загружают прямо сейчас (пассив: are being loaded), а пассажиры сами пройдут на посадку через десять минут (актив: will board).

prompt: The history museum was closed, so the pupils (to take) to the city zoo instead.
explanation_ru: Учеников отвели в зоопарк в рамках рассказа о прошлом (was closed), поэтому нужен Past Simple Passive: were taken.

prompt: Good news for you: your heavy box ___ to the local post office already.
explanation_ru: Коробка в единственном числе, и слово already требует Present Perfect Passive (has been + V3): has been delivered.

prompt: If you book this beach hotel early, you (to get) a room with a sea view.
explanation_ru: Вы сами получите номер с видом на море; в главной части условного предложения нужен Future Simple Active: will get.

prompt: Eric is happy because his new running shoes (to ship) from the warehouse.
explanation_ru: Радость в настоящем связана с тем, что кроссовки уже отправили со склада — нужен Present Perfect Passive: have been shipped.

prompt: While the professor (to explain) the chart, several students wrote down notes.
explanation_ru: Преподаватель сам объяснял схему в прошлом (while... wrote), поэтому используется Past Continuous Active: was explaining.

prompt: Carl feels much better now because his sore knee (to treat) by a great doctor.
explanation_ru: Улучшение самочувствия сейчас вызвано проведённым лечением (by a great doctor), поэтому нужен Present Perfect Passive: has been treated.

prompt: We spend sunny weekends working in our back garden. Usually, the young apple trees (to water) by my dad in the evening. Right now, he (to water) all the flower beds while I cut the grass.
explanation_ru: Обычный полив деревьев передаётся через Present Simple Passive (are watered), а действие папы прямо сейчас — через Present Continuous Active (is watering).

prompt: Seth could not swim today because the club pool (to clean) all morning.
explanation_ru: Бассейн чистили на протяжении всего утра в прошлом (could not swim), поэтому нужен Past Continuous Passive: was being cleaned.

prompt: Hi Neil, quick update: the main bridge ___ to traffic until six this evening.
explanation_ru: Текущее состояние моста описывается через Present Simple Passive (be + V3): is closed.

prompt: Ella was surprised when twenty friends (to arrive) at her house with balloons.
explanation_ru: Глагол arrive непереходный (друзья пришли сами) и никогда не ставится в пассив: arrived.

prompt: All fresh fish dishes ___ to order in the kitchen, so please allow twenty minutes.
explanation_ru: Блюда готовятся по заказу (множественное число dishes), поэтому нужен Present Simple Passive: are cooked.

prompt: We bought our tickets early, and a huge stage has been build in the city park.
answer: We bought our tickets early, and a huge stage has been built in the city park.
accepted_answers: We bought our tickets early, and a huge stage has been built in the city park.
explanation_ru: В форме Present Perfect Passive после has been требуется третья форма глагола build: built, а не build.

prompt: I wanted to try on the blue jacket, but the fitting rooms were being cleaned.
answer: I wanted to try on the blue jacket, but the fitting rooms were being cleaned.
accepted_answers: I wanted to try on the blue jacket, but the fitting rooms were being cleaned.
explanation_ru: В предложении нет ошибки: процесс уборки примерочных в прошлом верно передан через Past Continuous Passive (were being cleaned).

prompt: Great news from our sports club: new running machines ___ in the main hall!
explanation_ru: Тренажёры (machines — множественное число) уже установили в зале, поэтому нужен Present Perfect Passive: have been placed.

prompt: Phil manages the sales team in a busy downtown office. Every Monday morning, weekly targets (to share) with the staff. Yesterday, Phil (to present) a new plan to the directors. Tomorrow, copies of that plan (to send) to every desk.
explanation_ru: Еженедельное правило выражено пассивом (are shared), вчерашнее выступление Фила — активом (presented), а будущая рассылка копий — пассивом (will be sent).

prompt: When Iris arrived at the library, all the quiet study tables (to reserve) by other students.
explanation_ru: Столы уже были заняты другими студентами к моменту прихода Айрис в прошлом (arrived), поэтому нужен Past Simple Passive: were reserved.

prompt: Local residents are angry because three old oak trees (to cut) down near the river.
explanation_ru: Недовольство жителей сейчас вызвано тем, что деревья уже спилили — нужен Present Perfect Passive: have been cut.

prompt: The grammar test was hard because the students were explained the new rule too quickly.
answer: The grammar test was hard because the new rule was explained to the students too quickly.
accepted_answers: The grammar test was hard because the new rule was explained to the students too quickly.
The grammar test was hard because the new rule was explained too quickly.
explanation_ru: В пассивном залоге с глаголом explain подлежащим становится само правило (the new rule was explained), а не ученики.

prompt: Situation: We ordered two hot drinks at the coffee shop, and the waiter dropped our tray on the floor. Which sentence matches the situation?
options: Our hot drinks dropped the waiter on the floor.
Our hot drinks were dropped on the floor.
Our hot drinks were drop on the floor.
The waiter was dropped our hot drinks on the floor.
explanation_ru: Напитки уронили на пол (пассив: were dropped); остальные варианты искажают смысл или содержат грамматические ошибки.

prompt: Situation: The hotel staff is cleaning all the upstairs rooms right now. Which sentence matches the situation?
options: All the upstairs rooms are cleaning right now.
All the upstairs rooms are being cleaned right now.
All the upstairs rooms have been clean right now.
The hotel staff is being cleaned all the upstairs rooms right now.
explanation_ru: Номера убирают прямо сейчас (Present Continuous Passive: are being cleaned); вариант are cleaning означает, что комнаты убирают сами себя.

prompt: We stayed inside our tent while cold rain (to fall) heavily outside.
explanation_ru: Глагол fall непереходный (дождь шёл сам), а союз while вводит длительное действие в прошлом: was falling.

prompt: If you walk down Green Street, you (to see) the new fountain near the gate.
explanation_ru: Вы сами увидите новый фонтан; в главной части условного предложения первого типа нужен Future Simple Active: will see.

prompt: Situation: The local food store lowered the prices of fresh apples and oranges this morning. Which sentence matches the situation?
options: The prices of fresh apples and oranges were lowered this morning.
The prices of fresh apples and oranges lowered the store this morning.
The prices of fresh apples and oranges were lowering this morning.
The local food store was lowered the prices this morning.
explanation_ru: Цены снизили утром (Past Simple Passive: were lowered); остальные варианты нарушают залог или порядок слов.

prompt: I was happy when my new bank card (to arrive) in the morning post.
explanation_ru: Глагол arrive непереходный и не образует пассивный залог (карта пришла сама): arrived.
